summary: Our Bond, Inc. filed an 8-K to report amendments to an existing Equity Line SPA with Ascent Partners Fund LLC, reducing the maximum aggregate purchase price from $300M to $50M, modifying conditions for Expanded Closings, and adjusting warrant exercise prices while cancelling 15,991,902 + 300,000 warrants. The filing also notes issuance of a Promissory Note. These are routine contractual adjustments to a financing facility, not a transformative special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or restructuring event is involved.
